ObjectStates.Description:
SETUP: Choose Queens. Each player shuffles a 12-card starter Deck and draws 5. Shuffle Wardrobe and deal 5 face-up to form the Rack. Reveal one Stage.

TURN: Transformation → Reveal → Shopping → Slay / Dragdagulan† / Pass → Cleanup.

PLAY-GENERATED TIPS: play a card → gain its printed Tips → resolve text. Unplayed cards and old Masters do not generate printed Tips.

Shopping purchases go to Backstage Archive. Refill Rack during Cleanup, then draw 5.

Favorite Brand: Sugar Rush

Idol Perfect: Once per Round when you reveal a Matching Look, gain 1 Gross SP and draw 1 card.

Favorite Brand: Necropolis

From the Grave: Once during Transformation, play/equip one eligible non-Penalty card from your Backstage Archive as though it were in your hand.

SPECIAL APPEAL — Raise the Dead: Once per game during Transformation, equip one eligible Fashion card from your Backstage Archive as though it were in your hand. Resolve its Play ability normally and ignore any additional effect cost specifically required to equip that card.

ContainedObjects.Description:

Signature Tenet: Purple
Favorite Brand: Gilded Cage

More Is More: Whenever a card you play generates one or more printed Tips, gain 1 additional Tip. Whenever another single effect causes you to gain one or more Tips, gain 1 additional Tip. This bonus cannot trigger itself.

SPECIAL APPEAL — No Budget No Problem: Once per game during Shopping, reduce the cost of one Wardrobe purchase by 4 Tips, minimum 0. If the purchased card is Gilded Cage, draw 1 card afterward. Because Transformation has already ended, that drawn card normally cannot be played to generate its printed Tips this turn.

Signature Tenet: Blue
Favorite Brand: Necropolis

Toxic Entrance: When you equip a Necropolis Body as Master, choose an opponent; they discard 1 card from hand to their Backstage Archive if able.

SPECIAL APPEAL — Death Drop: Once per game when an opponent targets you with a hostile effect, cancel that effect. That opponent then loses 1 Tip, minimum 0.

ContainedObjects.Name: CardCustom
ContainedObjects.Description:

Favorite Brand: Multi-Brand / Fusion

Duality: Once per turn when you reveal a Complete Coordinate containing at least two non-Neutral Tenets, gain 2 Tips.

SPECIAL APPEAL — Dual Crown: Once per game during The Reveal, choose two non-Neutral Tenets represented in your Coordinate. For this Reveal, effects that check your Look's Tenet may treat it as either chosen Tenet. This does not satisfy a named Brand requirement by itself.

SPECIAL APPEAL — Perfect Geometry: Once per game during The Reveal, if all four core slots are occupied, choose one Master and one other Master. Add the first Master's printed Appeal to the second Master's contribution for this Reveal only.

Favorite Brand: Trash Can
